character_profiles.distinctive_facial_traits_en: Petite East Asian female around 22 with a delicate narrow V-line face, small pointed chin, and smooth high forehead. She has expressive almond eyes with narrow parallel double eyelids, subtle aegyo-sal, straight dark-brown eyebrows, a slender straight nose bridge with a refined rounded tip, and small full lips with a defined Cupid's bow. Her straight chin-length bob is dyed a rich burgundy-wine brown with sparse airy wispy bangs lightly grazing her eyebrows, paired with small silver drop hoop earrings.

Poised East Asian female around 26 with a balanced oval face, soft cheekbones, and a gently tapered chin. She features large rounded almond eyes with clear double eyelids, soft peach-brown eyeshadow, neatly arched light-brown eyebrows, a high straight nose bridge, and plump glossy coral-pink lips. Her warm chestnut-brown long hair is styled in a center part with soft S-wave curls framing her temples, complemented by matte gold square stud earrings and a delicate gold coin pendant necklace.

Approachable East Asian female around 25 with a soft oval-round face, full cheeks, and a rounded jawline. She has bright round doe eyes with subtle double eyelids, natural dark eyebrows, a straight medium-height nose bridge with a soft rounded tip, and natural rose-toned lips with minimal makeup. Her jet-black hair is tied back into a neat low ponytail with center-parted curtain bangs sweeping softly across her forehead temples, without earrings or glasses.
